'''TR4-121''' was a security surveillance camera in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], specifically the [[Room of a Thousand Fountains/Legends|Room of a Thousand Fountains]]. When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Anakin Skywalker, arrived to slaughter the Jedi during [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]]<ref name="Insider 87" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> TR4-121 recorded Skywalker killing [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]], the [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]].<ref name="Insider 87" />

When Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] [[Infiltration of the Jedi Temple/Legends|returned]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to recalibrate the Jedi beacon, Kenobi saw his former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] through the camera. What happened to it afterwards is uncertain.<ref name="Insider 87" />
